notes.title: Ver.1.0.5 Fix
notes.content:
Thank you for playing “Gensou Gold Rush”!
This is the first game we created and we are very happy that so many people are playing it!

We have added some features and fixed some bugs!
*Added “Screen Sickness Reduction Mode” in the options menu (some UI will not be displayed while playing).
*Fixed a bug that the language setting is inherited when you change the language in the options menu.
*Fixed a problem in which items that do not overwhelm the equipment slot (e.g., items that enhance the number of main shots) do not appear when four equipment items are acquired during the game.
*Fixed the speed of random shots of enemies to be a little bit slower.

Please keep up the good work!
